p, k = map(int, input().split())

MOD = 10**9 + 7

if k == 0:
    count = p - 1
elif k == 1:
    count = p
else:
    count = 0
    visited = [False] * p
    for i in range(1, p):
        if not visited[i]:
            visited[i] = True
            count += 1
            j = (i * k) % p
            while not visited[j]:
                visited[j] = True
                j = (j * k) % p

result = 1
for _ in range(count):
    result = (result * p) % MOD

print(result)
